svg.title: Rocq-Cats logo / Rocq-Cats 标志
svg.desc: The reference-traced cats above a centered signature: the official Rocq icon followed by the outlined wordmark Rocq-Cats. 上方保留参考图描摹的猫，下方居中排列 Rocq 官方图标与 Rocq-Cats 轮廓字标。
svg.metadata: Geometry traced from the user-supplied 1536 by 768 reference. Closed contours fitted with cubic Bezier curves at 0.24 source-pixel tolerance. The white background and smooth purple shading are vector paints; raster grain is omitted. The lower signature uses the original Rocq icon and outlined Instrument Rocq Bold lettering. No embedded images, fonts or external resources. Official assets: rocq-prover/rocq-prover.org, revision dc102d304f370d6ec9d58e311c1465fbdf67c2df. Rocq icon: UNLICENSE; font: Instrument Sans, SIL Open Font License.
